name: hishtory-server
description: hiSHtory(https://github.com/ddworken/hishtory) is a better shell history. It stores your shell history in context (what directory you ran the command in, whether it succeeded or failed, how long it took, etc). This is all stored locally and end-to-end encrypted for syncing to to all your other computers.

variables.name: HISHTORY_POSTGRES_DB
variables.description: Postgres DB Connection URI(https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/libpq-connect.html#LIBPQ-CONNSTRING). Special characters must be URL encoded(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL_encoding).

variables.name: HISHTORY_SQLITE_DB
variables.description: SQLite database path. Needs to be a mounted volume for persistence. Don't set at the same time as HISHTORY_POSTGRES_DB.
